description: Java AI application development framework (supports LLM-tool,skill; RAG; MCP; Agent-ReAct,Team-Agent). Compatible with java8 ~ java26. It can also be embedded in SpringBoot, jFinal, Vert.x, Quarkus, and other frameworks.
